```lua
local Models = {}
function Models.build(d)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = d.name
	local function part(name, size, pos, color, ball)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name, p.Size, p.Position, p.Color = name, size, pos, color
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.Massless = true, false, true
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		if ball then p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball end
		p.Parent = m
		return p
	end
	local b = part("Body", d.body, Vector3.new(0,d.body.Y/2,0), d.color, true)
	m.PrimaryPart = b
	b.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(0,-d.body.Y/2,0)
	local y = d.body.Y + d.head.Y/2 - .15
	part("Head", d.head, Vector3.new(0,y,-.25),d.color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.2),true)
	for i=1,d.eyes do
		local x = (i-(d.eyes+1)/2)*d.eyeSize*1.5
		part("Eye",Vector3.new(d.eyeSize,d.eyeSize,d.eyeSize),Vector3.new(x,y+.1,-.25-d.head.Z/2),Color3.new(1,1,1),true)
		part("Pupil",Vector3.new(d.eyeSize*.48,d.eyeSize*.6,.12),Vector3.new(x,y+.1,-.3-d.head.Z/2-d.eyeSize/2),Color3.fromRGB(18,24,46),true)
	end
	local hat = part("Hat",Vector3.new(d.head.X+ .35,.35,d.head.Z+.35),Vector3.new(0,y+d.head.Y/2, -.25),Color3.fromRGB(27,33,62))
	if d.style == "ears" or d.style == "crown" then
		for _,x in {-1,1} do part("Ear",Vector3.new(.7,1,.5),Vector3.new(x*.9,y+.6,0),d.color,true) end
	elseif d.style == "wings" or d.style == "orbit" then
		part("Wings",Vector3.new(4.7,.22,1),Vector3.new(0,1,0),Color3.fromRGB(255,211,78))
	elseif d.style == "cup" or d.style == "bowl" then
		part("Rim",Vector3.new(d.body.X+.4,.25,d.body.Z+.4),Vector3.new(0,d.body.Y-.1,0),Color3.new(1,1,1))
	else
		hat.Size = Vector3.new(.65,.9,.65)
	end
	for _,p in m:GetChildren() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= b then
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = b,p,b
		end
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size, gui.StudsOffset, gui.AlwaysOnTop = UDim2.fromOffset(180,46),Vector3.new(0,d.body.Y+d.head.Y+1,0),false
	gui.Parent = b
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size,t.BackgroundTransparency,t.TextColor3 = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),1,Color3.new(1,1,1)
	t.TextStrokeTransparency,t.Font,t.TextSize = .25,Enum.Font.GothamBold,13
	t.Text = d.name.."\n"..d.rarity.."  /  $"..d.rate.."/s"
	t.Parent = gui
	return m
end
return Models
```

```lua
local Economy = {states = {}}
local INCOME_TICK_SECONDS = 1
function Economy.add(player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name,stats.Parent = "leaderstats",player
	local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cash.Name,cash.Value,cash.Parent = "Cash",0,stats
	local s = {cash=cash,banked={},carried={},capacity=1,speed=16,rebirths=0,message="Catch a creature at the market!"}
	Economy.states[player] = s
	return s
end
function Economy.rate(s)
	local rate = 0
	for _,item in s.banked do rate += item.data.rate end
	return rate * (1+s.rebirths)
end
function Economy.costs(s)
	return {bag=25*s.capacity*s.capacity,boots=40+20*(s.speed-16),rebirth=1000*(s.rebirths+1)}
end
function Economy.apply(player)
	local s = Economy.states[player]
	local h = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if s and h then h.WalkSpeed = s.speed end
end
function Economy.buy(player,action)
	local s = Economy.states[player]
	if not s then return end
	local cost = Economy.costs(s)[action]
	if not cost or s.cash.Value < cost then s.message="Not enough cash" return end
	s.cash.Value -= cost
	if action=="bag" then s.capacity+=1
	elseif action=="boots" then s.speed=math.min(s.speed+4,48)
	elseif action=="rebirth" then
		for _,list in {s.banked,s.carried} do for _,item in list do item.model:Destroy() end end
		s.banked,s.carried,s.rebirths = {},{},s.rebirths+1
	end
	Economy.apply(player)
	s.message="Upgrade purchased!"
end
function Economy.start(push)
	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(INCOME_TICK_SECONDS) do
			for player,s in Economy.states do s.cash.Value += Economy.rate(s) push(player) end
		end
	end)
end
return Economy
```

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Catalog = require(RS.Shared.Catalog)
local Models = require(RS.Shared.Models)
local World = require(script.Parent.World).build()
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)
local Station = require(script.Parent.Station)
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name,remote.Parent = "ExpressState",RS
local wild = {}
local function push(p)
	local s = Economy.states[p]
	if not s then return end
	local hands = {}
	for _,item in s.carried do table.insert(hands,item.data.name) end
	remote:FireClient(p,{cash=s.cash.Value,income=Economy.rate(s),multiplier=1+s.rebirths,banked=#s.banked,
		capacity=s.capacity,speed=s.speed,hands=table.concat(hands,", "),costs=Economy.costs(s),
		waveAt=Station.waveAt,departureAt=Station.departureAt,imminent=Station.imminent,message=s.message})
end
local function catch(p,item)
	local s = Economy.states[p]
	local r = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not s or not r or not wild[item.model] or #s.carried>=s.capacity then return false end
	if (r.Position-item.model:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude>14 then return false end
	wild[item.model]=nil
	item.model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt"):Destroy()
	item.model:PivotTo(r.CFrame*CFrame.new((#s.carried)*2,0,2.5))
	for _,part in item.model:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Anchored=false end end
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Name,w.Part0,w.Part1,w.Parent = "CarryWeld",r,item.model.PrimaryPart,item.model.PrimaryPart
	table.insert(s.carried,item)
	s.message="Bring your cargo to the glowing wagon podium [F]."
	push(p)
	return true
end
local function spawnCreature(index,position)
	local d = Catalog[index]
	local m = Models.build(d)
	m.Parent=World.root
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
	local item={data=d,model=m}
	wild[m]=item
	local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText,prompt.ObjectText,prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = "Catch",d.name,Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration,prompt.MaxActivationDistance,prompt.RequiresLineOfSight,prompt.Parent=.15,10,false,m.PrimaryPart
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p) catch(p,item) end)
	return item
end
local function bank(p)
	local s = Economy.states[p]
	local r=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not s or not r or (r.Position-World.podium.Position).Magnitude>14 then return false end
	for _,item in s.carried do
		item.model.PrimaryPart.CarryWeld:Destroy()
		for _,part in item.model:GetDescendants() do if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Anchored=true end end
		table.insert(s.banked,item)
		item.model:PivotTo(World.slot(#s.banked))
	end
	s.carried={} s.message="Cargo banked. Your collection earns every second!"
	push(p)
	return true
end
local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText,prompt.ObjectText,prompt.KeyboardKeyCode="Bank cargo","YOUR WAGON",Enum.KeyCode.F
prompt.MaxActivationDistance,prompt.RequiresLineOfSight,prompt.Parent=12,false,World.podium
prompt.Triggered:Connect(bank)
local function joined(p)
	Economy.add(p)
	p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local s=Economy.states[p]
		for _,item in s.carried do item.model:Destroy() end
		s.carried={}
		local r=char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,4,8),Vector3.new(0,4,-12))
		Economy.apply(p) push(p)
	end)
	if p.Character then Economy.apply(p) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(joined)
for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do joined(p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	local s=Economy.states[p]
	if s then for _,list in {s.banked,s.carried} do for _,item in list do item.model:Destroy() end end end
	Economy.states[p]=nil
end)
local last={}
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,action)
	if typeof(action)~="string" then return end
	local now=os.clock()
	if now-(last[p] or 0)<.2 then return end
	last[p]=now
	if action~="sync" then Economy.buy(p,action) end
	push(p)
end)
for i=1,10 do spawnCreature(i,Vector3.new(-36+(i-1)*8,0,-3+(i%2)*7)) end
Economy.start(push)
Station.start(Economy,World,push)
task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(3) do
		local count=0
		for m in wild do
			count+=1
			local pos=m:GetPivot().Position
			local target=Vector3.new(math.clamp(pos.X+math.random(-4,4),-40,40),0,math.clamp(pos.Z+math.random(-3,3),-7,11))
			m:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(target,target+Vector3.new(0,0,-1)))
		end
		if count<10 then spawnCreature(math.random(1,10),Vector3.new(math.random(-36,36),0,math.random(-5,10))) end
	end
end)
-- Studio-only harness uses the same validated gameplay functions as prompts.
if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then
	local harness=Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	harness.Name="ExpressStudio"
	harness.OnInvoke=function(player,index,deposit)
		local r=player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		r.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,4,8)
		local caught=catch(player,spawnCreature(index,Vector3.new(1,0,8)))
		if deposit then
			r.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,5,29)
			bank(player)
		end
		local s=Economy.states[player]
		return caught,#s.banked,Economy.rate(s)
	end
	harness.Parent=script.Parent
end
```

### ServerScriptService.Server.Station

ModuleScript, 38 lines, matched to src/server/Station.luau

```lua
local Station = {}
local TICK_SECONDS = 0.5
local IMMINENT_SECONDS = 10
local WAVE_SECONDS, DEPARTURE_SECONDS = 45,90
function Station.start(economy,world,push)
	Station.waveAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+WAVE_SECONDS
	Station.departureAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+DEPARTURE_SECONDS
	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(TICK_SECONDS) do
			local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if now >= Station.waveAt then
				Station.waveAt = now+WAVE_SECONDS
				for p,s in economy.states do
					if not world.onTrain(p) and #s.carried>0 then
						for _,item in s.carried do item.model:Destroy() end
						s.carried={} s.message="WAVE! Your loose cargo was swept away. Banked cargo is safe."
					end
				end
				local wave = Instance.new("Part")
				wave.Name,wave.Size,wave.Position = "SkyWave",Vector3.new(94,5,2),Vector3.new(0,2,-24)
				wave.Anchored,wave.CanCollide,wave.Material,wave.Transparency = true,false,Enum.Material.Neon,.45
				wave.Color,wave.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(70,200,255),workspace
				game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(wave,TweenInfo.new(2),{Position=Vector3.new(0,2,24)}):Play()
				game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(wave,2)
			end
			if now >= Station.departureAt then
				Station.departureAt=now+DEPARTURE_SECONDS
				for p,s in economy.states do
					if world.onTrain(p) then s.cash.Value+=economy.rate(s)*10 s.message="ALL ABOARD! 10-second income bonus."
					else s.message="Express departed! Be aboard next time for a cash bonus." end
				end
			end
			Station.imminent = math.min(Station.waveAt-now,Station.departureAt-now)<=IMMINENT_SECONDS
			for p in economy.states do push(p) end
		end
	end)
end
return Station
```

```lua
local World = {}

function World.build()

	World.root,World.podium = root,podium
	return World
end
function World.onTrain(player)
	local r = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return r ~= nil and r.Position.Z > 26 and r.Position.Z < 40 and math.abs(r.Position.X)<42
end
function World.slot(index, lane)
	return CFrame.new(-8+((index-1)%3)*8,3.3+(math.floor((index-1)/3))*4.5,35+(lane or 0))
end
return World
```
